s.note: from the corn he grows in the park
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then salt. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix with 3 diced tomatoes, chopped coriander and the juice of 2 limes. Serve the salsa in a bowl with the chips.

s.n: Pantry stash grilled peaches and honey
s.how: Drain 2 tins peach halves (800g) and pat dry. Heat a griddle pan over high heat, brush with a little butter and grill the peaches cut side down for 4 minutes until charred and caramelised. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey. Toast 40g flaked almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes. Serve the warm peaches with the yoghurt, almonds and a dusting of cinnamon.

m.note: cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York
m.how: Season 4 sirloins well and sear in a hot pan for 3 minutes a side. Add 50g butter, 2 crushed garlic cloves and thyme and baste for a minute. Rest 5 minutes and slice. Keep a plain unseasoned piece aside for the dog.

w.note: rationed sweets in a locked-down house
w.how: Heat the oven to 150C. Butter a 1.5 litre baking dish. Stir 100g short grain rice, 60g caster sugar and 1 litre full cream milk together in the dish and add a long strip of lemon peel. Grate nutmeg over the top and dot with 20g butter. Bake 2 to 2.5 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes, until thick and creamy with a golden skin. Rest 10 minutes and serve warm with a spoon of raspberry jam.

d.note: the bottle Robert keeps in the lab
d.how: Drain a 410g tin of sliced peaches, keeping 60ml of the syrup. Muddle half the peach slices with the syrup, the juice of 1 lemon and 10 mint leaves in a shaker. Add 200ml bourbon and ice and shake 15 seconds. Strain into 4 tumblers packed with crushed ice. Garnish each with a peach slice and a mint sprig.
